cases.name: clip-circle
cases.script: x.beginPath(); x.arc(20,20,12,0,Math.PI*2); x.clip(); x.fillStyle='#c63'; x.fillRect(0,0,40,40); x.fillStyle='#000'; x.fillRect(0,18,40,4);

cases.name: clip-nested-save-restore
cases.script: x.save(); x.beginPath(); x.rect(4,4,24,24); x.clip(); x.save(); x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(0,0); x.lineTo(40,40); x.lineTo(0,40); x.closePath(); x.clip(); x.fillStyle='red'; x.fillRect(0,0,40,40); x.restore(); x.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,255,0.5)'; x.fillRect(0,0,40,40); x.restore(); x.fillStyle='green'; x.fillRect(30,30,8,8);

cases.name: clip-evenodd-transformed
cases.script: x.translate(20,20); x.rotate(0.3); x.beginPath(); x.rect(-15,-15,30,30); x.rect(-7,-7,14,14); x.clip('evenodd'); x.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0); x.fillStyle='#909'; x.fillRect(0,0,40,40);

cases.name: linear-gradient
cases.script: var g=x.createLinearGradient(4,0,36,0); g.addColorStop(0,'red'); g.addColorStop(0.5,'yellow'); g.addColorStop(1,'blue'); x.fillStyle=g; x.fillRect(0,5,40,30);

cases.name: linear-gradient-diagonal-alpha-stroke
cases.script: var g=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,40,40); g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.addColorStop(1,'#0a0'); x.globalAlpha=0.7; x.fillStyle=g; x.fillRect(0,0,40,40); var h=x.createLinearGradient(0,20,40,20); h.addColorStop(0,'#f0f'); h.addColorStop(1,'#0ff'); x.strokeStyle=h; x.lineWidth=4; x.strokeRect(6,6,28,28);

cases.name: linear-gradient-transformed
cases.script: x.translate(20,20); x.rotate(Math.PI/4); var g=x.createLinearGradient(-10,0,10,0); g.addColorStop(0,'#fff'); g.addColorStop(1,'#000'); x.fillStyle=g; x.fillRect(-14,-14,28,28);

cases.name: radial-gradient-concentric-ring
cases.script: var g=x.createRadialGradient(20,20,6,20,20,18); g.addColorStop(0,'red'); g.addColorStop(0.5,'orange'); g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,255,0.3)'); x.fillStyle=g; x.fillRect(0,0,40,40);

cases.name: pattern-repeat
cases.script: function src(w,h){var s=document.createElement('canvas'); s.width=w; s.height=h; var c=s.getContext('2d'); c.fillStyle='#e22'; c.fillRect(0,0,w,h); c.fillStyle='#22e'; c.fillRect(0,0,w/2,h/2); c.fillRect(w/2,h/2,w/2,h/2); c.fillStyle='rgba(0,160,0,0.5)'; c.fillRect(1,1,w-2,2); return s;} var p=x.createPattern(src(8,8),'repeat'); x.fillStyle=p; x.translate(3,2); x.fillRect(0,0,33,30);

cases.name: pattern-no-repeat-and-repeat-x
cases.script: function src(w,h){var s=document.createElement('canvas'); s.width=w; s.height=h; var c=s.getContext('2d'); c.fillStyle='#e22'; c.fillRect(0,0,w,h); c.fillStyle='#22e'; c.fillRect(0,0,w/2,h/2); c.fillRect(w/2,h/2,w/2,h/2); c.fillStyle='rgba(0,160,0,0.5)'; c.fillRect(1,1,w-2,2); return s;} x.fillStyle=x.createPattern(src(8,6),'no-repeat'); x.fillRect(0,0,40,20); x.fillStyle=x.createPattern(src(8,6),'repeat-x'); x.translate(0,24); x.fillRect(0,-4,40,16);

cases.name: draw-image-canvas
cases.script: function src(w,h){var s=document.createElement('canvas'); s.width=w; s.height=h; var c=s.getContext('2d'); c.fillStyle='#e22'; c.fillRect(0,0,w,h); c.fillStyle='#22e'; c.fillRect(0,0,w/2,h/2); c.fillRect(w/2,h/2,w/2,h/2); c.fillStyle='rgba(0,160,0,0.5)'; c.fillRect(1,1,w-2,2); return s;} x.drawImage(src(10,10),5,7); x.drawImage(src(6,6),30,30);

cases.name: draw-image-scaled-up
cases.script: function src(w,h){var s=document.createElement('canvas'); s.width=w; s.height=h; var c=s.getContext('2d'); c.fillStyle='#e22'; c.fillRect(0,0,w,h); c.fillStyle='#22e'; c.fillRect(0,0,w/2,h/2); c.fillRect(w/2,h/2,w/2,h/2); c.fillStyle='rgba(0,160,0,0.5)'; c.fillRect(1,1,w-2,2); return s;} x.drawImage(src(8,8),2,2,25,20);

cases.name: draw-image-subrect-scaled-down
cases.script: function src(w,h){var s=document.createElement('canvas'); s.width=w; s.height=h; var c=s.getContext('2d'); c.fillStyle='#e22'; c.fillRect(0,0,w,h); c.fillStyle='#22e'; c.fillRect(0,0,w/2,h/2); c.fillRect(w/2,h/2,w/2,h/2); c.fillStyle='rgba(0,160,0,0.5)'; c.fillRect(1,1,w-2,2); return s;} x.drawImage(src(32,32),4,4,24,24,10,10,12,12);

cases.name: draw-image-rotated-alpha
cases.script: function src(w,h){var s=document.createElement('canvas'); s.width=w; s.height=h; var c=s.getContext('2d'); c.fillStyle='#e22'; c.fillRect(0,0,w,h); c.fillStyle='#22e'; c.fillRect(0,0,w/2,h/2); c.fillRect(w/2,h/2,w/2,h/2); c.fillStyle='rgba(0,160,0,0.5)'; c.fillRect(1,1,w-2,2); return s;} x.translate(20,20); x.rotate(0.5); x.globalAlpha=0.6; x.drawImage(src(16,16),-8,-8);

cases.name: put-image-data
cases.script: x.fillStyle='#888'; x.fillRect(0,0,40,40); x.translate(5,5); var d=x.createImageData(10,6); for(var i=0;i<d.data.length;i+=4){d.data[i]=200; d.data[i+1]=i%255; d.data[i+2]=30; d.data[i+3]=(i*7)%256;} x.putImageData(d,3,4);

cases.name: put-image-data-dirty
cases.script: var d=new ImageData(12,12); for(var i=0;i<d.data.length;i+=4){d.data[i+2]=255; d.data[i+3]=255;} x.fillStyle='red'; x.fillRect(0,0,40,40); x.putImageData(d,10,10,2,3,6,4); x.putImageData(x.getImageData(0,0,12,12),28,28);
